split_pairs: All three are train-validation. No train-test or validation-test candidate was returned by this pHash screen.
observation: All three flagged pairs show the same source photograph with minor changes. No conflicting class was observed in these pairs. Absence of a pHash match does not prove independence by vehicle, photographer or photo sequence.

annotation_review.method: Two photos per class per split, selected with Python random.Random(42), boxes overlaid and inspected.
annotation_review.observation: Labels and boxes are broadly consistent with visible vehicle condition in the reviewed sample. This is not a full semantic annotation audit. Damaged boxes sometimes describe a damaged region while undamaged boxes generally enclose vehicles.

empty_label_review.observation: Both show a visible vehicle but contain no boxes. This is a coverage omission for vehicle-condition detection; no replacement class was assigned and no source file changed.
